text:
elaine: Quick sync — scheduling a design review for the API + SDK + Console UX changes around the unified client config. Need a 45m slot next week (preferably Mon/Tue). Pre-read will be the PR, a 5-min demo, and a short checklist. Who can attend? @sam @devin @karim please weigh in.

sam: I can do Mon after 2pm or Tue morning. 45m works. Will invite product too.

devin: Tue morning is best for me. Can we keep it focused — want to review the API surface + auth changes first.

karim: I’m out Mon afternoon. Tue 9:30–10:15p (9:30–10:15a) could work. I think we might need ~60 if UX folks have questions.

lisa: I can lead the Console demo and run the preflight checklist. Happy to keep it tight — we can mark follow-ups.

elaine: Thanks — plan: propose Tue 09:30–10:15 (45m), slot owners: @lisa demo, @sam API rundown, @devin auth/compat notes. If we need more time we’ll spin a separate follow-up.

calendar-bot: Poll created: https://calendar.redwood.internal/poll/Ab12cd — please cast availability by EOD.

pr-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/unified-client-config/pull/482 — contains API spec + changelog.

sam: Quick ask — can PR include a short table mapping old->new config keys? That'll speed review.

devin: +1 to mapping table. Also add a snippet showing migration example.

elaine: Good call. I’ll add a migration example under 'Usage' + a small table.

elaine: Preflight checklist (add to PR description):
```
- Read PR summary (2 min)
- View demo gif / live demo (5 min)
- API surface: endpoints + params (5 min)
- Auth migration notes (3 min)
- Console UX flows impacted (5 min)
- Rollout plan + fallback (3 min)
- Blockers & known regressions (1 min)
```

karim: Can we add a short perf/latency note? If the config changes affect client init we should mention expected impact.

elaine: Will add perf note (benchmarks and local numbers).

lisa: Requesting design reviewer: @marco from product design — can someone ping him?

sam: I’ll DM Marco and add him to the invite.

elaine: Thanks. Last ask: if you have specific asks for the session (e.g., API approval, UX sign-off, migration go/no-go), add them as one-line items in the PR comment so we can surface them as agenda bullets.

devin: Adding: "approve auth compatibility, confirm migration fallback" as agenda items.

karim: I’ll add perf numbers and a short note about impact on cold starts.

calendar-bot: Event tentative: Tue 2065460100 09:30–10:15 saved to eng calendar; invites pending.

elaine: Awesome — thanks everyone. If poll shows conflicts we’ll look at Wed AM as fallback. :thumbsup:
